author: MiniWarGaming
description:
In this video, we’re trying out Bloodwork - a dark fantasy co-op campaign game where your decisions affect not only the outcome of a mission, but the entire story as it unfolds. You’re controlling a small group of mercenaries trying to survive in a world that’s falling apart after the death of a god.

Check out Bloodwork:  The Reckoning on Gamefound:
https://www.miniwargaming.com/bloodwork
